instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, medium full shot. On an outdoor sports court next to a green metal fence, two girls pose together in soft daylight. The girl in the patterned bandana and plaid shirt (R2) stands on the left, leaning against a green post and looking forward. The girl in the pink bucket hat and pink hoodie (R1) stands on the right, leaning her right arm on the shoulder of the girl in the bandana (R2) while looking off to the right. The background is softly blurred with natural green tones.
